Risk Factors

Changes in tax laws could increase our effective tax rate. Antitrust investigations could require changes to our business practices. Failure to comply with capital requirements could limit our ability to pay dividends. New legislation could impose additional compliance costs on our operations. We are subject to extensive regulation and supervision by government authorities. We cannot predict the timing or extent of these developments. Our mitigation efforts may not be sufficient.

Investors increasingly scrutinize our net zero commitments and climate disclosures. The energy transition toward low-carbon sources may affect our long-term strategy. Policies to reduce greenhouse gas emissions may lower demand for our products. Carbon pricing mechanisms could increase our compliance costs. Climate change regulation could increase the cost of our operations. Our mitigation efforts may not be sufficient. Any of these events could harm our financial condition.
